name: Honduras
famous_for: Roatán coral reef diving in the Bay Islands, ancient Maya ruins of Copán with hieroglyphic stairway, and Baleadas.
tourists: Over 2.2M visitors; top attractions include West Bay beach in Roatán, Copán Ruinas, and Pico Bonito National Park.
must_know: The Baleada—a thick handmade flour tortilla folded over refried beans, queso duro, and mantequilla—is a national culinary staple.
fun_fact: Copán contains the Hieroglyphic Stairway, boasting the longest known inscribed Maya hieroglyphic text in the Americas.
